versions.research_rationale: EO 12076 (signed 1978-08-18, 43 FR 37161-37162), read in full from the held FR text, places 17 positions in level IV and 14 positions in level V of the Executive Schedule (secs. 1-101, 1-102), preserves the appointments of incumbents (sec. 1-201) and revokes EO 11861, as amended (sec. 1-202). The order has no sunset, termination or report clause. The machine own-term kinds ('condition' and an undated 'fixed_term', plus a quoted conflict) are all noise: they were picked up from other documents printed on the same Federal Register pages (the public-inspection notice, a list of rules going into effect, and a Governors' proclamation), not from the order. EO 12154 (signed 1979-09-04, 44 FR 51965, held FR text, read in full; reading record LSP-EO_12154) sec. 1-202 revokes it 'as amended' with no effective-date wording, so the revocation took effect on signing. Three orders amended EO 12076 before that and were read in full: EO 12099 (1978-11-17) moves the Director of Policy Review, Department of Defense, from level V (item 1-102(e)) to level IV (new item (r)); EO 12111 (1979-01-02) deletes the Interior position in item 1-102(g) and adds a Commerce position as (s); EO 12119 (1979-02-14) deletes the Justice position in item 1-101(f) and inserts a Treasury position. Those three items therefore have an earlier first end than the revocation (1-102(e) on 1978-11-17, 1-102(g) on 1979-01-02, 1-101(f) on 1979-02-14), and the two list leads carry all three amendments as later events; every other clause ends with the revocation. Inventory correction: the dossier's 31 item clauses mis-bound items (q) and (n-dup2) and omit secs. 1-201 and 1-202 (see inventory_overrides, 35 clauses). A by-number scan finds EO 12076 named only in EO 12099, 12111, 12119 and 12154; the dossier conflict (a quarantined Stage 19 relationship) is addressed in conflict_resolutions. EO 12154's own sec. 1-201 and the successor placements are described in savings_residuals.

savings_residuals.reason: Reading record LSP-EO_12154 (EO 12154, 44 FR 51965, read once in full): sec. 1-101 and 1-102 place positions in levels IV and V, sec. 1-201 provides that 'Nothing in this Order shall be deemed to terminate or otherwise affect the appointment, or to require the reappointment, of any occupant of any position listed in Section 1-1 of this Order who was the occupant of that position immediately prior to the issuance of this Order', and sec. 1-202 revokes EO 12076, as amended. The sec. 1-201 proviso protects the incumbents of the positions that EO 12154 itself lists, which re-places a number of the positions that EO 12076 placed (for example the Senior Adviser to the Secretary of State, the Administrator of ADAMHA, the Deputy Under Secretary for International Labor Affairs, the Special Assistant to the Special Representative for Trade Negotiations and the Executive Director of the PBGC). Own-residual check, reading EO 12076 in full: it placed positions in the Executive Schedule and, in sec. 1-201, protected incumbents' appointments; the placements are functions of the order that EO 12154 carries forward by re-listing the positions, and appointments made while EO 12076 was in force are not undone by its revocation. Positions that EO 12154 does not re-list lose their Executive Schedule placement; the order created no other right, fund or property. The S4 prefill ('review') is resolved as transferred_or_accrued (functions carried forward and appointments preserved), on the same ground as the Executive Schedule successor chain.
